details: monogrok is a heavily-obfuscated bulk-mailer and SMTP-abuse toolkit. Every JavaScript file under cmds/, func/, utils/, and the top-level entry (package.json main/bin = oibWljdTg.js) is javascript-obfuscator output with hex-mangled identifiers. Modules present include SMTP credential brute-forcing (func/smx/passgo.js, func/smx/aws.js, func/smx/sendgrid.js), Shodan-driven discovery of AWS SES / SendGrid / mail relays (func/sho/*, _init/props/.smtp/Aws/shodan_queries.txt targeting email-smtp.*.amazonaws.com), mass-mailing engines (func/snd/mlr/*), proxy/IP rotation (func/ipr/*, cmds/pxy.js), redirect chains (func/rdt/*), and operator-configurable notification/exfil hooks (Discord webhook, Telegram bot, ALERT_EMAIL). README markets the package as a bulk mailing server (mntmc.rip). No install/postinstall lifecycle scripts, no import-time reads of installer secrets (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser stores), and no hardcoded exfiltration of installer-owned data were observed — the toolkit acts on external SMTP servers, mailboxes, and recipients that the operator configures, not on the installer's own host or credentials.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
